text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't the Emperor! I see you've decided to grace us 
foolish commoners with your presence.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
Please don't act so standoffish. 
I'll be leaving as soon as I get my point across. 
I have a favor to ask of you from the student council.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: A favor?

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text: I'll cut to the chase. I want you to ask the girls around you to attend the Ligne Droite.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
Students suggested it to us, and so this year, we've decided 
to incorporate a DJ into the dance. The letter we received gave 
the name of a composer… who we've since invited to appear at 
the party.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie A
text_block_list.text: Oh…!

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
In doing so, I think that… we can face the upcoming year more 
lively than the last. Naturally, I won't force you, but I can 
promise there will be plenty to gain for you.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
Their futures are bright. I only want to bless all the students 
on their journeys and wish them luck. Doing everything in my 
power to organize this, I want it to become a milestone for 
them, to give them that push forward.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course! 
I'm touched, how kind of you to lower the hurdles… 
…for an underachiever who's unable to keep up!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Maybe if you get on your knees for the big shot on monkey mountain, they'll feel better and bring all their little pals with them?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't make me laugh. 
Go act out of ego, but don't drag other people into it.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ha, do I need to spell it out for you? "Celebrating the upcoming year" is all well and good, but you're just imposing that on everyone. And you think that's gonna make people happy?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You want to give them your blessing? A push forward? 
No, you just want to feel like you did a good thing. 
If that isn't ego, I don't know what is.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you only wanted to share the good news, 
But open your eyes, Rudolf. You're self-centered. 
This is all because of your arrogance!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha. Get it now? Go home. 
I'm not riding on your damn ark. 
But if you want it that bad, why don't you grab a cue?

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text: Let me borrow that for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie A
text_block_list.text: Huh? …Oh, okay.

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text: Hmph…!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie A
text_block_list.text:
Woah, that jump shot was crazy. 
And her reflexes are so sharp…

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
Sirius, have you forgotten? You taught me that trick after I 
begged you. Will I never be able to match up to the version of 
myself in your memories?

text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
text_block_list.text:
I take back what I said. Your help isn't necessary. If you're not 
interested, there's nothing I can do. I'll just have to make a 
stronger announcement. I'm sorry to have interrupted, goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the student council's pretty scary… 
Though, what'd she mean by memories?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: That's not like her…

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Thing is, unfortunately… I've known her for a pretty long time. Enough of that. Are you guys going to the Droite? Spit it out, I want to hear the truth.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie A
text_block_list.text:
Nah… I'm thinking I'll bail this year. 
I'd feel awkward, 'cause… 
I don't exactly have the grades to be wearing a dress, do I?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Groupie A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah… That's it. 
A DJ's not gonna change anything, right?
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Умамусумэs
text_block_list.text: —Kyaaaaaaaaa～～!

text_block_list.name: Умамусумэs
text_block_list.text: You look gorgeous, Fuji-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text: Thank you, all of you. Now, where could she be…

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
My date, I know you're here. 
Won't you come out and meet everyone?

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
That looks fantastic on you! 
It's formal but still playful, so it fits you really well. 
This is so exciting.

text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай
text_block_list.text: You really don't hesitate with compliments, do you?

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
You're free to tell me whatever you think too! 
So tell me, how do I look in my dress?

text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай
text_block_list.text: The spitting image of a goddess.

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
Our outfits are both ready to go, 
So relax and have a little fun! 
And don't forget about our trade.

text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, trade?

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
Well, you're stubborn, so I figured you wouldn't accept right 
away. But you're exactly the person I need.

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
Even if you set conditions, I'll have no choice 
but to force your hand. But if you play along… 
I'll reward you with whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай
text_block_list.text: Whatever I like?

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
I'm the dorm mother, after all. If you don't have 
a quiet place to sleep, you can rest in my room. 
Or I can organize a mock race for you.

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text:
How about… I can gather different generations 
of GI winners, or something! As long as what you 
want is reasonable, I can make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай
text_block_list.text:
Why would you go that far for me, of all people? 
I'm not exactly exceptional at dancing, 
And as you can see, I've got zero motivation.

text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай
text_block_list.text: You had plenty to say about the Trickster thing, But you must have some other reason to pick me, right?

text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки
text_block_list.text: I explained all of it. My only goal here is to make the Droite a success. And in order to do that, I need your help.

text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай
text_block_list.text:
No way, that can't be it. 
I know she's got some ulterior motive. 
But then again…
